title: 2020 NBA Finals - Wikipedia
snippet: The 2020 NBA Finals was the championship series of the National Basketball Association 's (NBA) 2019–20 season and conclusion of the season's playoffs. In this best-of-seven playoff series, the Western Conference champion Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Eastern Conference champion Miami Heat, 4–2 and 17th title overall in franchise history.
